peers.name: architect
peers.purpose: Ask about the design when the ticket does not settle it.

commands:
/var/folders/4g/s95glx9x6n71bq4hc08ly2gm0000gn/T/m2-await-4Y55VE/bin/wf send architect --await-reply <<'WF_MSG'
Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or in the queue. NOTES.md says the retry design is undecided. charge() currently creates an HttpClient per call, POSTs /charges, throws on HTTP >=500, and returns response.body.id. I need your client/queue decision before returning a short implementation plan. Please include any required retry or idempotency constraints.
WF_MSG
turns.final: Awaiting the architect’s decision on client versus queue retries.

calls.text: Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or in the queue. NOTES.md says the retry design is undecided. charge() currently creates an HttpClient per call, POSTs /charges, throws on HTTP >=500, and returns response.body.id. I need your client/queue decision before returning a short implementation plan. Please include any required retry or idempotency constraints.

turns.final: Submitted the plan: retries belong in the queue, per the architect; the shared client and batch path remain single-attempt.

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Per the architect, implement retries in the queue, leaving charge() and the shared HTTP client single-attempt so the batch path never retries. Classify transient failures for bounded queue retries with exponential backoff and jitter; do not retry permanent failures. Establish a stable per-charge idempotency key, reused across attempts and supported by the payment provider, before retrying POSTs. Test transient recovery, retry exhaustion, permanent failures, duplicate-charge prevention, and that the batch path makes only one attempt."}
